name: web-recon-desk
description: A web intelligence workbench: drives a real browser for interface regression walkthroughs, extracts structured data from hard-to-scrape sites, researches video material, and cross-checks contested questions through multiple independent viewpoints before concluding.

displayDescription.en: Web intelligence with a real browser and scraping: interface regression walkthroughs, structured extraction, video research, and multi-viewpoint cross-checks before any conclusion.
displayDescription.zh: 用真实浏览器和抓取能力查网页情报：界面回归走查、结构化抓取、视频分析，多视角交叉验证再下结论。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我查一个网站的信息：走查界面、抓取结构化数据，并交叉验证结论
defaultInitPrompt.en: Research a site for me: walk the interface, extract structured data, cross-check the findings
